## Review checklist
- [ ] Scope matches the issue and approved design.
- [ ] Relevant acceptance criteria have evidence.
- [ ] Comments/docs explain non-obvious behavior.
- [ ] Unity assets include stable .meta files where applicable.
- [ ] No generated caches, secrets, or license credentials.
- [ ] Tested/playtested/accepted status is represented accurately.
